title: Maria Watches Over Us 3rd Season OVA
native: マリア様がみてる～3rdシーズンOVA～
synopsis:
Summer has arrived at last, and with it comes the promise of summer break for the students of Lillian Girls’ Academy. Sachiko and Yumi retreat to the summer home of the Ogasawara family for a season of rest and relaxation, but their rosy trip soon sours when some old friends of Sachiko’s unexpectedly drop in. These wealthy snobs turn up their noses at Yumi and Sachiko’s relationship — and if Yumi isn’t careful, her blissful summer at Sachiko’s side could come to an abrupt and tearful end.

(Source: Maiden Japan)

episodes.title: The Lambs' Vacation
episodes.synopsis: Yumi and Sachiko head out to the Ogasawara family's summer home, but what was supposed to be a relaxing vacation takes a turn for the worse when some of Sachiko's old acquaintances drop by for tea.

episodes.title: Operation OK For Short
episodes.synopsis: Wanting to help Sachiko overcome her hatred of men, Yumi arranges a meeting with the Hanadera student council. After all, both Lillian and Hanadera have to work together on their school festivals so it would be a good idea, right?

episodes.title: Cool Breeze
episodes.synopsis: Yumi has a stalker - Kanako Hosokawa! Kanako seems to think that Yumi is the perfect Lillian girl, but she's got a few things to learn about the real Yumi.

episodes.title: Ready, Go!
episodes.synopsis: In hopes of making up with Kanako, Yumi makes a bet over the outcome of the Athletic Festival.

episodes.title: Hello Sister!
episodes.synopsis: Yumi, Yoshino, and Shimako, head off to Italy on a school field trip. It's an experience they'll never forget.
